name: morph-icon
title: Morph Icon
description: A stroke icon that morphs into the next one on a spring when its icon changes: matched strokes rotate and glide, the rest split or merge. Takes any 24x24 stroke icon data. No dependencies.
author: Guillermo López <https://guillermolg.com>
docs:
Installed `MorphIcon` (`@/components/ui/morph-icon`) with its driver (`morph-icon-dom`) and its geometry core (`morph-icon-core`). No dependencies.

```tsx
import { MorphIcon, type IconNode } from "@/components/ui/morph-icon";

const menu: IconNode = [["path", { d: "M4 5h16" }], ["path", { d: "M4 12h16" }], ["path", { d: "M4 19h16" }]];
const close: IconNode = [["path", { d: "M18 6 6 18" }], ["path", { d: "m6 6 12 12" }]];

<button type="button" aria-label="Menu" aria-pressed={open} onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
  <MorphIcon icon={open ? close : menu} />
</button>
```

Change `icon` to morph. Icons are data, not components: pass a `[tag, attrs]` node list or a path `d` for any stroke-drawn icon on a 24x24 grid (Lucide's icon nodes, or your own). Filled glyphs do not morph cleanly. `from`, `to` and `progress` freeze a morph for scrubbing. Motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion` by default.
